ClientId.description: A client identifier of at most 256 bytes.

ContractsMember.description: Which definitions the client may request.

oneOf.description: The definitions the service publishes for this client.

Only the definitions in a reviewed contracts file, written by
`evidencectl client contracts fetch`; a relative path resolves against
the profile's directory.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

ExpectedDefinitionMember.description: What the client expects of one definition it requests.

assuranceProfile.description: The assurance profile the service states.

evidenceType.description: The evidence type an assertion for the definition names.

purpose.description: The purpose the client states when it requests the definition.

responseFormat.description: The response format the client requests.

ExpectedMember.description: What the client expects the service to state.

audience.description: The audience an accepted assertion names.

definitions.description:
Pins for selected definition handles. A service may publish other
definitions without changing the meaning of this profile.

issuer.description:
The issuer an accepted assertion names. It is an identity the service
states, compared exactly, not a URL the client fetches.

provider.description: The provider an accepted assertion names.

ExpectedResponseFormat.description: A response format the client verifies on its own.

oneOf.description: A flattened JWS carrying the Evidence payload.
A compact SD-JWT VC carrying the same payload.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

OauthMember.description:
Fixed OAuth request parameters for the token acquisition.

`clientAssertionAudience` is who checks the client's authentication JWT;
`resource` is the RFC 8707 resource indicator the token's audience must
name. Neither is `expected.audience`, the Evidence assertion's audience.

clientAssertionAudience.description: The audience of the client's authentication JWT.

resource.description: The resource indicator the token request carries.

scopes.description: The scopes the token request asks for.

PrivateKeyMember.description:
Where the client's private signing key is read from: a file, or an
environment variable holding the JSON Web Key.

oneOf.description:
A file holding the key; a relative path resolves against the
profile's directory.
An environment variable holding the key.

ProfilePath.description: A file path, relative to the profile's directory or absolute.

ResourceIndicator.description: An RFC 8707 resource indicator: an absolute URI with no fragment.

TrustMember.description: How the client learns the keys that sign Evidence responses.

oneOf.description: Fetch the service's published keys over https.

Fetch the published keys of a service on `http://127.0.0.1`, for
local development only.

Trust only the keys in a reviewed JSON Web Key Set file; a relative
path resolves against the profile's directory.

UriIdentity.description: An absolute URI the service states as an identity, compared exactly.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host, no user information, and no whitespace or control character.

VerificationMember.description: Bounds on the assertions the client accepts.

clockSkewSeconds.description:
The clock difference tolerated when checking an assertion's times, in
seconds. Omitted, it is 30.

maximumAssertionLifetimeSeconds.description:
The longest validity an accepted assertion may state, in seconds.
Omitted, it is 300.

description:
An Evidence relying-party client profile: where the Evidence service is,
how this client authenticates to it, which keys and contracts it trusts,
and what it expects the service to assert.

baseUrl.description:
The Evidence service origin: scheme, host, and port, with no path,
query, fragment, or trailing slash, in lowercase. It uses `https`,
except `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` under `local-loopback-discovery`
trust. Under `https-discovery` and `pinned-jwks` trust the host is not
a loopback, private, link-local, unspecified, or cloud metadata
address.

clientId.description:
The client identifier the Evidence service's token issuer knows this
client by.

contracts.description:
Which definitions the client may request. Omitted, it uses the
definitions the service publishes for it.

expected.description:
What the client expects the service to state about itself and about
the definitions it requests.

maximumMetadataCacheSeconds.description:
How long the client keeps the service's discovery metadata, in
seconds. Omitted, it is 600.

oauth.description:
Fixed OAuth request parameters for the token acquisition, for issuers
whose client-assertion audience, resource indicator, or requested
scopes are not derivable from discovery. Omitted members keep the
discovery-driven behavior.

privateKey.description: Where the client's private signing key, a JSON Web Key, is read from.

trust.description:
How the client learns the keys that sign Evidence responses. Omitted,
it fetches the service's published keys over https.

verification.description: Bounds on the assertions the client accepts.
